items.title: Salon / shop license
items.body: The shop itself may need its own license. Lapse it and fines can follow.

items.title: Stylist licenses
items.body: Every stylist and booth renter has their own expiration date.

items.title: Liability insurance
items.body: Landlords and clients may ask for proof. A lapse leaves you exposed.

items.title: Business license
items.body: Your city or county license usually renews on its own date. Easy to miss.

cta.title: Never miss a *renewal*
cta.body: CertTrack tracks every license and policy and alerts you before they expire.
